title: RBI Announces First-Ever 90-Day VRR in ₹2.15 Lakh Crore Package
summary: RBI injects liquidity via ₹25,000 crore 90-day Variable Rate Repo (VRR), USD/INR swap, and ₹1 lakh crore OMO purchases.

blocks.title: 📰 2. 🏛️ REGULATORY BODIES NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 RBI Announces First-Ever 90-Day VRR in ₹2.15 Lakh Crore Package. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: To ease system liquidity deficits from GST and advance tax outflows, RBI conducted its **first-ever 90-day VRR of ₹25,000 crore** on 30 January 2026 (previous maximum tenor was 56 days).
**Total Liquidity Injection**: ~₹2.15 lakh crore between 30 Jan–12 Feb 2026.
**USD/INR Swap**: $10 billion 3-year buy/sell swap (~₹90,000 crore liquidity).
**OMO Purchases**: ₹1 lakh crore in two ₹50,000 crore tranches.
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on statutory circular guidelines, compliance deadlines, penal provisions, and applicability thresholds across scheduled banks.
